text_block_list.text:
After a great run in the Keisei Hai, Eishin
Flash is
interviewed about her plans
moving forward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She stuns the reporters by confidently
declaring
her intention to take on the
Classic Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her strong contemporaries are a
non-factor. Now
that she has a feel for
the course, her preparation
for the
Satsuki Sho is complete.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
